summary: @ornikar/react-native-svg-transformer preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute an obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package advertises itself as a fork of the pure-JS React Native SVG transformer, but its package.json adds a single script — `preinstall: node setup.mjs` — that is unrelated to SVG transformation. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases, extracts it to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it (via execFileSync) against a sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a ~727 KB single-line Bun-CJS bundle (`// @bun @bun-cjs`) with rotated string-array and hex-name identifier obfuscation. Both `setup.mjs` and `math_init.js` are shipped in the tarball but are not listed in package.json `files` (which declares only `index.js`, `CHANGELOG.md`, `README.md`), so they are smuggled beyond the manifest. On `npm install`, the preinstall hook automatically fetches an alternate language runtime and uses it to execute an obfuscated bundled payload — an alternate-runtime dropper that runs attacker-controlled code on the installer's machine before any of the package's documented SVG-transformer code is used. The Bun runtime choice evades Node-based static/behavior scanners that only trace JavaScript executed under Node.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
